glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意) - 目 (“eye”) + 卩 (“kneeling person”) – a kneeling human figure with a large eye for a head. Similar but unrelated to 艮. See also 夏 and 監.
s_page_origin: Simplified form of 見 from cursive script.
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 見; s_page_origin explains the simplified 见.
